dataInvalidMessage.title: Data Invalid Message
dataInvalidMessage.description: This attribute allows to set the message to be displayed if the data to be loaded for the chart is invalid. To display an image as the chart message, prefix __I-__ to the image URL.

dataInvalidMessageFont.title: Data Invalid Message Font
dataInvalidMessageFont.description: This attribute allows to set the font for the message displayed if the specified chart data is invalid.

dataInvalidMessageFontSize.title: Data Invalid Message Font Size
dataInvalidMessageFontSize.description: This attribute allows to set the font size for the message displayed if the specified chart data is invalid.

dataInvalidMessageColor.title: Data Invalid Message Color
dataInvalidMessageColor.description: This attribute allows to set the font color for the message displayed if the specified chart data is invalid.

dataInvalidMessageImageHAlign.title: Data Invalid Message Image H Align
dataInvalidMessageImageHAlign.description:
If an image is displayed as the chart `dataInvalidMessage`, this attribute allows to set a custom horizontal alignment for the image. 

Default value: value assigned to the `baseChartMessageImageHAlign` attribute

dataInvalidMessageImageVAlign.title: Data Invalid Message Image V Align
dataInvalidMessageImageVAlign.description:
If an image is displayed as the chart `dataInvalidMessage`, this attribute allows to set a custom vertical alignment for the image. 

Default value: value assigned to the `baseChartMessageImageVAlign` attribute

dataInvalidMessageImageAlpha.title: Data Invalid Message Image Alpha
dataInvalidMessageImageAlpha.description:
If an image is displayed as the chart `dataInvalidMessage`, this attribute allows to set the transparency of the image. 

Default value: 100

dataInvalidMessageImageScale.title: Data Invalid Message Image Scale
dataInvalidMessageImageScale.description:
If an image is displayed as the chart `dataInvalidMessage`, this attribute allows to set the scale for magnifying the image. 

Default value: 100

extraConfigurationSchema.title: The Datasource Schema of a FusionChart of type gantt

dateFormat.title: Date Format
dateFormat.description: This attribute helps you specify the input date format for all the dates in your XML. This is a mandatory attribute to specify and once specified, all the dates in your XML data should conform to the format specified herein.

outputDateFormat.title: Output Date Format
outputDateFormat.description: You can also specify how the dates look on your Gantt chart using this attribute. This attribute takes the output date format as string. You can build your own output date format string as explained in the section "Configuring date formats".

ganttPaneDuration.title: Gantt Pane Duration
ganttPaneDuration.description: If you want your Gantt pane to scroll through a specified time line, you can use this attribute to set what timeline the pane will represent. For example, if you want your Gantt pane to show date only for 3 months and then scroll the rest, you can set this attribute as 3. More of this has been explained in the section "Enable scrolling".

ganttPaneDurationUnit.title: Gantt Pane Duration Unit
ganttPaneDurationUnit.description: If you've opted to scroll the Gantt pane, this attribute lets you choose the unit of your specified duration. More of this has been explained in the section "Enable scrolling".

showFullDataTable.title: Show Full Data Table
showFullDataTable.description: Whether to show full names of the process labels and data columns in grid. If you set this as on, the labels will not wrap and always show in full. When required, a scroll bar will automatically appear for the entire grid.

ganttWidthPercent.title: Gantt Width Percent
ganttWidthPercent.description: You can opt to set the width of the Gantt view pane in percent using this attribute. The rest of the width will be taken by the grid. If the data grid takes lesser space, the chart will automatically adjust the Gantt pane to assume more width.

forceGanttWidthPercent.title: Force Gantt Width Percent
forceGanttWidthPercent.description: If you want the chart to never automatically adjust the Gantt width and stick to the percent width that you've specified, you can set this attribute to 1.

showTaskStartDate.title: Show Task Start Date
showTaskStartDate.description: For each task bar in the Gantt chart, you can show its respective start date on its left. To do so, set this attribute as 1.

showTaskEndDate.title: Show Task End Date
showTaskEndDate.description: For each task bar in the Gantt chart, you can show its end date value too by setting this attribute as 1.

showTaskLabels.title: Show Task Labels
showTaskLabels.description: Whether to show task labels for each task bar in the Gantt chart. The task labels show up only if they've been defined for the task.

showPercentLabel.title: Show Percent Label
showPercentLabel.description: If you've used the percentage task feature, you can opt to show the percent complete for each task as part of the task label by setting this attribute as 1.

showSlackAsFill.title: Show Slack As Fill
showSlackAsFill.description: If you've used the percentage task feature, you can opt to show the slack (percent of work not completed) as either a filled bar or empty bar. To draw as empty bars, set this attribute as 0.

slackFillColor.title: Slack Fill Color
slackFillColor.description: If you've opted to fill the slack bars with color, you can define the color code for the same here.

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: Whether to animate the chart while rendering? If you define this attribute as 0, even your custom defined Style animations will not work.

animationDuration.title: Animation Duration
animationDuration.description:
This attribute sets the animation duration of the chart. `animationDuration` attribute is applicable only if animation of the chart is enabled. 

Default value: 1 sec

clickURL.title: Click U R L
clickURL.description: Click URL for the entire chart. The entire chart can then act as a hotspot. This URL can be provided in FusionCharts Link format.

clickURLOverridesPlotLinks.title: Click U R L Overrides Plot Links
clickURLOverridesPlotLinks.description:
Sets whether the `clickURL` attribute (that sets a link to which the user is directed when the chart is clicked) overrides the `link` attribute (that sets a link to which the user is directed when a data plot is clicked). 

Default value: 0 (`clickURL` does not override `link`)

extendCategoryBg.title: Extend Category Bg
extendCategoryBg.description: If you set this attribute as 1, the Gantt pane grid will take the same background and border properties as that of the last category (visual dateline) defined.

showPrintMenuItem.title: Show Print Menu Item
showPrintMenuItem.description: Whether to show "Print Chart" item in the context menu of the chart? Even if you opt to hide the item in context menu, you can still opt to invoke `print()` JavaScript method of the chart to print the same.

scrollToDate.title: Scroll To Date
scrollToDate.description: Chart will automatically scroll to the given date at the time of rendering. This attribute will only work when `ganttPaneDuration` and `ganttPaneDurationUnit` attributes are set as per requirement. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

useVerticalScrolling.title: Use Vertical Scrolling
useVerticalScrolling.description: Whether to display the vertical scroll bar or not. By default, the attribute is set to 1 and the vertical scroll bar appears depending on the height of the chart. More of this has been explained in the section "Enable scrolling". This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

forceRowHeight.title: Force Row Height
forceRowHeight.description: When the process rows do not occupy the complete height of the chart, this attribute is used to specify the row height configuration. If set to true, each row is set to its own height. Otherwise, the rows occupy the total available height equally. Default value is false.

captionOnTop.title: Caption On Top
captionOnTop.description: Whether caption should be on top of the data plot area

captionFontSize.title: Caption Font Size
captionFontSize.description: Sets the caption font size in pixels. Besides pixels (px) values can also be defined in rem, %, em, and vw.

subCaptionFontSize.title: Sub Caption Font Size
subCaptionFontSize.description: Sets the sub-caption font size (in pixels). Besides pixels (px) values can also be defined in rem, %, em, and vw.

captionFontBold.title: Caption Font Bold
captionFontBold.description: Whether the caption font should be displayed in bold

subCaptionFontBold.title: Sub Caption Font Bold
subCaptionFontBold.description: Whether the sub caption font should be displayed in bold

alignCaptionWithCanvas.title: Align Caption With Canvas
alignCaptionWithCanvas.description: Whether the caption is aligned with the canvas. Else, it will be aligned with the entire chart area

captionHorizontalPadding.title: Caption Horizontal Padding
captionHorizontalPadding.description:
If caption is not centre aligned, lets you configure the padding (in pixels) from either edge.
Will be ignored if caption is centre aligned.

hasRTLText.title: Has R T L Text
hasRTLText.description: This attribute, when set to __1__, indicates to the chart that the text (rendered on the chart) may contain RTL characters and the textual display has to be managed accordingly.

plotHighlightEffect.title: Plot Highlight Effect
plotHighlightEffect.description:
This attribute lets you enable/disable the highlight effect, in the form of a `fadeout`, for the data plots corresponding to a legend item. When this attribute is enabled and the mouse pointer is hovered over a legend item label, plots belonging to the other data series fadeout, by reducing their opacity.

 The fadeout effect can be customized by specifying the fadeout color and opacity using the `color` and `alpha` attributes. Eg. `fadeout|color=#ff0000, alpha=60`

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: This attribute changes the theme of the chart. There are 7 types of themes which have been made according to the different color combinations.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Which pre-defined color palette to use

paletteThemeColor.title: Palette Theme Color
paletteThemeColor.description: If you want your own palette derived from a particular hex color, you can specify the same here. All other colors on the chart will automatically derive from that palette.

bgColor.title: Bg Color
bgColor.description: This attribute sets the background color for the chart. You can set any hex color code as the value of this attribute. To specify a gradient as background color, separate the hex color codes of each color in the gradient using comma. Example: `FF5904, FFFFFF`. Remember to remove # and any spaces in between.

bgAlpha.title: Bg Alpha
bgAlpha.description: Sets the alpha (transparency) for the background. If you've opted for gradient background, you need to set a list of alpha(s) separated by comma.

bgRatio.title: Bg Ratio
bgRatio.description: If you've opted for a gradient background, this attribute lets you set the ratio of each color constituent.

bgAngle.title: Bg Angle
bgAngle.description: Angle of the background color, in case of a gradient.

showBorder.title: Show Border
showBorder.description: Whether to show a border around the chart or not?

bgImage.title: Bg Image
bgImage.description: To place any image (JPG/PNG/GIF) as background of the chart, enter the (path and) name of the background image. It should be in the same domain as the chart.

bgImageAlpha.title: Bg Image Alpha
bgImageAlpha.description: This attribute specifies the opacity for the loaded background image.

bgImageDisplayMode.title: Bg Image Display Mode
bgImageDisplayMode.description: Helps you specify the mode in which the background image is to be displayed. Stretch - expands the image to fit the entire chart area, without maintaining original image constraints. Tile - the image is repeated as a pattern on the entire chart area. Fit - fits the image proportionately on the chart area. Fill -proportionately fills the entire chart area with the image. Center - the image is positioned at the center of the chart area. None - Default mode.

bgImageVAlign.title: Bg Image V Align
bgImageVAlign.description: Helps you to vertically align the background image.

bgImageHAlign.title: Bg Image H Align
bgImageHAlign.description: Helps you to horizontally align the background image.

bgImageScale.title: Bg Image Scale
bgImageScale.description: Helps you magnify the background image.This attribute will only work when the attribute `bgImageDisplayMode` is set to none, center, or tile.

showcanvasborder.title: Showcanvasborder
showcanvasborder.description:
This attribute if set to _1_, shows a border around the canvas of the chart. 

__Default value__: 0

canvasBgColor.title: Canvas Bg Color
canvasBgColor.description: This attribute sets the background color for the chart canvas. You can set any hex color code as the value of this attribute. To specify a gradient as canvas background color, separate the hex color codes of each color in the gradient using comma. Example: #FF5904, #FFFFFF.

canvasBgAlpha.title: Canvas Bg Alpha
canvasBgAlpha.description: This attribute sets the background transparency for the chart canvas. For gradient, separate the alpha value using comma. Example: 15, 50.

canvasBgRatio.title: Canvas Bg Ratio
canvasBgRatio.description: When a gradient is used to set the color of the canvas background, this attribute sets the ratio of the colors. Example : If the value of the `canvasBgColor` attribute is set as `#FF5904, #FFFFFF`, `canvasBgRatio` can be used to specify their ratio in the background.

canvasBgAngle.title: Canvas Bg Angle
canvasBgAngle.description: Helps you specify canvas background angle in case of gradient.

canvasBorderColor.title: Canvas Border Color
canvasBorderColor.description: Lets you specify canvas border color.

canvasBorderThickness.title: Canvas Border Thickness
canvasBorderThickness.description: Lets you specify canvas border thickness.

canvasBorderAlpha.title: Canvas Border Alpha
canvasBorderAlpha.description: Lets you control transparency of canvas border.

ganttLineColor.title: Gantt Line Color
ganttLineColor.description: Lets you specify the color in which the grid border for the Gantt pane view will be drawn.

ganttLineAlpha.title: Gantt Line Alpha
ganttLineAlpha.description: Alpha for the grid border of Gantt view pane.

gridBorderColor.title: Grid Border Color
gridBorderColor.description: Color for the data grid border.

gridBorderAlpha.title: Grid Border Alpha
gridBorderAlpha.description: Alpha for the data grid border.

gridResizeBarColor.title: Grid Resize Bar Color
gridResizeBarColor.description: Color for the drag line that appears when resizing the data grid.

gridResizeBarThickness.title: Grid Resize Bar Thickness
gridResizeBarThickness.description: Thickness of the drag line that appears when resizing the data grid,

gridResizeBarAlpha.title: Grid Resize Bar Alpha
gridResizeBarAlpha.description: Alpha of the drag line that appears when resizing the data grid.

taskBarRoundRadius.title: Task Bar Round Radius
taskBarRoundRadius.description: If you want your task bars to be rounded (when not using percent complete feature), you can set the radius of the round corner here. That'll result in all task bars having rounded corners.

taskBarFillMix.title: Task Bar Fill Mix
taskBarFillMix.description: This attribute lets you specify the gradient fill formula for the task bars. Example: `{light-10},{light-20},{light-60}`

taskBarFillRatio.title: Task Bar Fill Ratio
taskBarFillRatio.description: If you're using gradient fill formula for the task bars, this attribute lets you specify the ratio for each color in the gradient.

baseFont.title: Base Font
baseFont.description: Global font face for all text on the chart. You can individually customize font properties of each element using their respective attributes or Styles.

baseFontSize.title: Base Font Size
baseFontSize.description: Global font size for all text on the chart. Besides pixels (px) values can also be defined in rem, %, em, and vw.

baseFontColor.title: Base Font Color
baseFontColor.description: Global font color for all text on the chart.

showShadow.title: Show Shadow
showShadow.description: Whether to apply the shadow effect for the task bars?

logoURL.title: Logo U R L
logoURL.description: You can load an external logo (JPEG/PNG) to your chart, this attribute lets you specify the URL. Due to cross domain security restrictions it is advised to use a logo from the same domain name as your charts.

logoLeftMargin.title: Logo Left Margin
logoLeftMargin.description: This attribute helps you set the amount of empty space that you want to put on the left side of your logo image. Nothing is rendered in this space.

logoTopMargin.title: Logo Top Margin
logoTopMargin.description: This attribute helps you set the amount of empty space that you want to put on top of your logo image. Nothing is rendered in this space.

logoPosition.title: Logo Position
logoPosition.description: Where to position the logo on the chart: TL - Top-left TR - Top-right BR - Bottom right BL - Bottom left CC - Center of screen

logoAlpha.title: Logo Alpha
logoAlpha.description: Once the logo has loaded on the chart, you can configure its opacity using this attribute.

logoScale.title: Logo Scale
logoScale.description: You can also change the size of externally loaded logo at run-time by specifying a value for this parameter.

logoLink.title: Logo Link
logoLink.description: If you want to link the logo to an external URL, specify the link in this attribute. The link can be in FusionCharts link format, allowing you to link to new windows, pop-ups, frames etc.

manageResize.title: Manage Resize
manageResize.description: Setting this attribute to 1, you can allow the chart to automatically resize itself when the parent container of the chart is resized.

useEllipsesWhenOverflow.title: Use Ellipses When Overflow
useEllipsesWhenOverflow.description: When enabled in AUTO mode, long data labels are truncated by adding ellipses to prevent them from overflowing the chart background. The default value is 1.

showToolTip.title: Show Tool Tip
showToolTip.description: Whether to show tooltip for the chart?

tooltipBorderAlpha.title: Tooltip Border Alpha
tooltipBorderAlpha.description: Sets the border transparency for tool tip.

dateInToolTip.title: Date In Tool Tip
dateInToolTip.description: Whether to show starting and ending date for each task in tooltip?

showToolTipShadow.title: Show Tool Tip Shadow
showToolTipShadow.description: Whether to show shadow for tooltips.

plottooltext.title: Plottooltext
plottooltext.description:
Specify custom text for the tooltip 

 You can either specify a constant string as the tooltip text or you can use variable values from the data level by prefixing a __$__ to the attribute name, for example, __$name__, __$value__.

toolbarPosition.title: Toolbar Position
toolbarPosition.description: Where to position the toolbar on the chart: TL - Top-left TR - Top-right BR - Bottom right BL - Bottom left CC - Center of screen

toolbarX.title: Toolbar X
toolbarX.description: Sets the toolbox position on the chart with respect to x-axis.

toolbarY.title: Toolbar Y
toolbarY.description: Sets the toolbox position on the chart with respect to y-axis.

toolbarHAlign.title: Toolbar H Align
toolbarHAlign.description: Sets the horizontal alignment of the toolbar on the chart.

toolbarVAlign.title: Toolbar V Align
toolbarVAlign.description: Sets the vertical alignment of the toolbar on the chart

toolbarButtonColor.title: Toolbar Button Color
toolbarButtonColor.description: Sets the color of the toolbar buttons.

showToolBarButtonTooltext.title: Show Tool Bar Button Tooltext
showToolBarButtonTooltext.description: Enables/disables display of tooltips for toolbar buttons.

toolbarButtonScale.title: Toolbar Button Scale
toolbarButtonScale.description: You can change the scale of the toolbar by specifying a value for this attribute.

exportEnabled.title: Export Enabled
exportEnabled.description:
Whether the chart will allow exporting to images, PDFs, SVG, XLSX or CSV format.  

__Default value__: 0

exportAction.title: Export Action
exportAction.description:
In case of server-side exporting, the action specifies whether the exported image will be sent back to client as download, or whether it'll be saved on the server. 

__Default value__: download

exportHandler.title: Export Handler
exportHandler.description: In case of server side exporting, this refers to the path of the server-side export handler (the ready-to-use scripts that we provide).

exportFormats.title: Export Formats
exportFormats.description: Lets you configure what output formats to allow for export of chart, in the export context menu, and also customize the label for each menu item. The attribute value should be a pipe (|) delimited separated key-value pair. Example: `exportFormats: 'PNG=Export as High Quality Image|JPG|PDF=Export as PDF File'`

exportMode.title: Export Mode
exportMode.description:
This attributes sets the modes of export. To enable client-side exporting, set this attribute to __client__. 

__Default value__: auto. 

__Note__: Starting v3.12.1, the `exportMode` attribute replaces the `exportAtClientSide` attribute. However, you don’t need to make any changes to the existing setup because, the FusionCharts library comes with the proper mapping already provided.

exportShowMenuItem.title: Export Show Menu Item
exportShowMenuItem.description: Whether the menu items related to export (e.g., Save as JPEG etc.) will appear in the context menu of chart.

exportTargetWindow.title: Export Target Window
exportTargetWindow.description:
In case of server-side exporting and when using download as action, this lefts you configure whether the return image, PDF, SVG or XLSX will open in same window (as an attachment for download), or whether it will open in a new window. 

__Default value__: _self

exportFileName.title: Export File Name
exportFileName.description: Using this attribute you can specify the name (excluding the extension) of the output (export) file.

showHoverEffect.title: Show Hover Effect
showHoverEffect.description: When set to 0, disables all the hover bands and hover effects all over the chart. The value of this attribute is overridden by the value of `showHoverBand`, `showProcessHoverBand` and `showCategoryHoverBand` attributes. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

plotHoverEffect.title: Plot Hover Effect
plotHoverEffect.description: Whether to enable hover effect on charts for data plots (e.g., column, pie) only

plotFillHoverColor.title: Plot Fill Hover Color
plotFillHoverColor.description: Specifies the hover color for the data plots

plotFillHoverAlpha.title: Plot Fill Hover Alpha
plotFillHoverAlpha.description: Specifies the hover alpha for data plots

showHoverBand.title: Show Hover Band
showHoverBand.description: Whether to show the vertical and horizontal hover band for both the `categories` and the `processes` objects. This atrribute overrides the value of `showHoverEffect` attribute. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

hoverBandColor.title: Hover Band Color
hoverBandColor.description: Lets you set the hover band color of both the `categories` and the `processes` objects. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

hoverBandAlpha.title: Hover Band Alpha
hoverBandAlpha.description: Lets you set the transparency of the hover band for both the `categories` and the `processes` objects. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

showCategoryHoverBand.title: Show Category Hover Band
showCategoryHoverBand.description: Whether to show the vertical color band on mouse hover for the `categories` object. The value of this attribute overrides the value of the `showHoverEffect` attribute. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

categoryHoverBandColor.title: Category Hover Band Color
categoryHoverBandColor.description: Lets you set the hover band color for multiple `categories` objects. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

categoryHoverBandAlpha.title: Category Hover Band Alpha
categoryHoverBandAlpha.description: Lets you set the transparency of the hover band for multiple `categories` objects. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

showGanttPaneVerticalHoverBand.title: Show Gantt Pane Vertical Hover Band
showGanttPaneVerticalHoverBand.description: Whether to show the color band of Gantt pane on mouse hover for multiple `categories` objects. The value of this attribute overrides the value `showHoverEffect` attribute. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

showProcessHoverBand.title: Show Process Hover Band
showProcessHoverBand.description: Whether to show the horizontal hover band for the `processes` object on mouse hover. The value of this attribute overrides the value `showHoverEffect` attribute. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

processHoverBandColor.title: Process Hover Band Color
processHoverBandColor.description: Lets you set the hover band color for all `processes` objects. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

processHoverBandAlpha.title: Process Hover Band Alpha
processHoverBandAlpha.description: Lets you set the transparency of the hover band for all `processes` objects. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

showGanttPaneHorizontalHoverBand.title: Show Gantt Pane Horizontal Hover Band
showGanttPaneHorizontalHoverBand.description: Whether to show the hover bands for the `processes` object of the Gantt pane on mouse hover. The value of this attribute overrides the value `showHoverEffect` attribute. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

showConnectorHoverEffect.title: Show Connector Hover Effect
showConnectorHoverEffect.description: Whether to display the mouse hover effect on connector lines. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

connectorHoverColor.title: Connector Hover Color
connectorHoverColor.description: Lets you set the hover color of the connector lines. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

connectorHoverAlpha.title: Connector Hover Alpha
connectorHoverAlpha.description: Lets you set the transparency of the hover color of the connector lines. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

connectorHoverThickness.title: Connector Hover Thickness
connectorHoverThickness.description: Lets you set the thickness of the connector lines after the mouse cursor hover. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

showTaskHoverEffect.title: Show Task Hover Effect
showTaskHoverEffect.description: Whether to use the mouse hover effect of task bars. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

taskHoverFillColor.title: Task Hover Fill Color
taskHoverFillColor.description: Lets you set the color of task fill on mouse hover. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

taskHoverFillAlpha.title: Task Hover Fill Alpha
taskHoverFillAlpha.description: Lets you set the transparency of the task fill on mouse hover. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

slackHoverFillColor.title: Slack Hover Fill Color
slackHoverFillColor.description: Lets you set the hover color of the task bar slack. This attribute is not applicable when `showSlackAsFill` is set to 0. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

slackHoverFillAlpha.title: Slack Hover Fill Alpha
slackHoverFillAlpha.description: Lets you set the transparency of the hover color of the task bar slack fill. This attribute is not applicable when `showSlackAsFill` is set to 0. This feature is supported by JavaScript Gantt chart only.

showLegend.title: Show Legend
showLegend.description: Whether to show legend for the chart?

legendShadow.title: Legend Shadow
legendShadow.description: Whether to show a shadow for legend?

legendAllowDrag.title: Legend Allow Drag
legendAllowDrag.description: The legend can be made drag-able by setting this attribute to 1. End viewers of the chart can drag the legend around on the chart.

legendScrollBgColor.title: Legend Scroll Bg Color
legendScrollBgColor.description: If you've too many items on the legend, a scroll bar shows up on the same. This attribute lets you configure the background color of the scroll bar.

reverseLegend.title: Reverse Legend
reverseLegend.description: You can reverse the ordering of datasets in the legend by setting this attribute to 1.

legendIconScale.title: Legend Icon Scale
legendIconScale.description: Scaling of legend icon is possible in FusionCharts XT. This attribute lets you control the size of legend icon.

legendItemFontBold.title: Legend Item Font Bold
legendItemFontBold.description: Whether legend keys should be displayed in bold

legendNumColumns.title: Legend Num Columns
legendNumColumns.description: If your chart contains multiple series, the legend is displayed as a grid comprising of multiple legend keys. With the help of this attribute you can specify the number of columns that are to be displayed in the legend.

drawCustomLegendIcon.title: Draw Custom Legend Icon
drawCustomLegendIcon.description:
Specifies whether drawing a custom legend icon will be enabled. All legend icon customization attributes will work only if this feature is enabled. 

Default value: 0 (disabled)

legendIconBorderColor.title: Legend Icon Border Color
legendIconBorderColor.description:
Sets the border color for the legend icon. 

Default value: Data plot border color

legendIconBgColor.title: Legend Icon Bg Color
legendIconBgColor.description:
Sets the background color for the legend icon. 

Default value: Data plot fill color

legendIconAlpha.title: Legend Icon Alpha
legendIconAlpha.description:
Sets the legend icon transparency. 

Default value: 100

legendIconBgAlpha.title: Legend Icon Bg Alpha
legendIconBgAlpha.description:
Sets the legend icon background transparency. 

Default value: 100

legendIconSides.title: Legend Icon Sides
legendIconSides.description:
Sets the number of sides for the legend icon. 

Default value: 4

legendIconBorderThickness.title: Legend Icon Border Thickness
legendIconBorderThickness.description:
Sets the thickness of the legend icon border. 

Default value: 1

legendIconStartAngle.title: Legend Icon Start Angle
legendIconStartAngle.description:
Sets the starting angle of for drawing the legend icon. 

Default value: 45

scrollPosition.title: Scroll Position
scrollPosition.description:
Sets the position of the scrollbar in the chart. 

 __Default Value:__ Bottom

scrollPadding.title: Scroll Padding
scrollPadding.description: Vertical padding between the scroll bar and chart canvas.

scrollBtnPadding.title: Scroll Btn Padding
scrollBtnPadding.description: Horizontal padding between the scroll bar and its buttons.

flatscrollbars.title: Flatscrollbars
flatscrollbars.description:
This attribute can be used to set the scroll bar to flat or the basic one. 

__Default value__: 1

chartLeftMargin.title: Chart Left Margin
chartLeftMargin.description: Amount of empty space that you want to put on the left side of your chart. Nothing is rendered in this space.

chartRightMargin.title: Chart Right Margin
chartRightMargin.description: Amount of empty space that you want to put on the right side of your chart. Nothing is rendered in this space.

chartTopMargin.title: Chart Top Margin
chartTopMargin.description: Amount of empty space that you want to put on the top of your chart. Nothing is rendered in this space.

chartBottomMargin.title: Chart Bottom Margin
chartBottomMargin.description: Amount of empty space that you want to put at the bottom of your chart. Nothing is rendered in this space.

taskDatePadding.title: Task Date Padding
taskDatePadding.description: Horizontal padding between the task bars and start of date labels (if you've opted to show them for the chart).

captionPadding.title: Caption Padding
captionPadding.description: This attribute lets you control the space (in pixels) between the sub-caption and top of the chart canvas. If the sub-caption is not defined, it controls the space between caption and top of chart canvas. If neither caption, nor sub-caption is defined, this padding does not come into play.

legendPadding.title: Legend Padding
legendPadding.description: Padding of legend from bottom side of canvas.

milestoneFont.title: Milestone Font
milestoneFont.description:
Sets the font family for the milestone label 

__Note__: The custom milestone label is defined using the `label` attribute belonging to the `milestone` object.

milestoneFontSize.title: Milestone Font Size
milestoneFontSize.description:
Sets the font  size for the milestone label 

__Note__: The custom milestone label is defined using the `label` attribute belonging to the `milestone` object.

payload.description: The Gantt chart is used for showcasing timelines. It is a date/time-based chart that allows plotting tasks with their exact start and end date/time. Milestones can also be defined to assert how much of the project should be completed by when. Broadly, this chart looks like an extended version of the bar chart.The chart canvas is divided into a view pane and a data table. Tasks and their start and end date/time are listed in the view pane. Horizontal bars, representing tasks, are shown in the data table. The length of the bar represents the duration of the task. Arrows are used to connect tasks and star or a polygon is used to represent milestones. This chart can be used to show the timelines for the various phases in the construction of a new store.
