xAxisNameBgColor.title: X Axis Name Bg Color
xAxisNameBgColor.description: Sets the background color for x-axis text

xAxisNameBorderColor.title: X Axis Name Border Color
xAxisNameBorderColor.description: Sets the border around the x-axis text

xAxisNameAlpha.title: X Axis Name Alpha
xAxisNameAlpha.description: Sets the x-axis alpha including font and background

xAxisNameBorderDashed.title: X Axis Name Border Dashed
xAxisNameBorderDashed.description:
Whether the border around the x-axis name should be rendered using dashed lines. 

__Default value__: 0 (border rendered using straight lines)

xAxisNameBorderDashLen.title: X Axis Name Border Dash Len
xAxisNameBorderDashLen.description: Sets the length of each dash when the border around the x-axis name is rendered using dashed lines.

xAxisNameBorderDashGap.title: X Axis Name Border Dash Gap
xAxisNameBorderDashGap.description: Sets the gap between consecutive dashes when the border around the x-axis name is rendered using dashed lines.

yAxisNameFont.title: Y Axis Name Font
yAxisNameFont.description: Sets the y-axis (primary / secondary) font family for the text

yAxisNameFontColor.title: Y Axis Name Font Color
yAxisNameFontColor.description: Sets the y-axis (primary / secondary) font color

yAxisNameFontSize.title: Y Axis Name Font Size
yAxisNameFontSize.description: Specifies the y-axis (primary / secondary) font size. Besides pixels (px) values can also be defined in rem, %, em, and vw.

yAxisNameFontBold.title: Y Axis Name Font Bold
yAxisNameFontBold.description: Whether y-axis (primary / secondary) font should be bold

yAxisNameFontItalic.title: Y Axis Name Font Italic
yAxisNameFontItalic.description: Whether y-axis (primary / secondary) font should be italicized

yAxisNameBgColor.title: Y Axis Name Bg Color
yAxisNameBgColor.description: Sets the background color for y-axis (primary / secondary) text

yAxisNameBorderColor.title: Y Axis Name Border Color
yAxisNameBorderColor.description: Sets the border around the y-axis (primary / secondary) text

yAxisNameAlpha.title: Y Axis Name Alpha
yAxisNameAlpha.description: Sets the y-axis (primary / secondary) alpha including font and background

yAxisNameFontAlpha.title: Y Axis Name Font Alpha
yAxisNameFontAlpha.description: Sets the y-axis (primary / secondary) font alpha

yAxisNameBgAlpha.title: Y Axis Name Bg Alpha
yAxisNameBgAlpha.description: Sets the y-axis (primary / secondary) background alpha

yAxisNameBorderAlpha.title: Y Axis Name Border Alpha
yAxisNameBorderAlpha.description: Sets the y-axis (primary / secondary) border alpha

yAxisNameBorderPadding.title: Y Axis Name Border Padding
yAxisNameBorderPadding.description: Sets the y-axis (primary / secondary) border padding

yAxisNameBorderRadius.title: Y Axis Name Border Radius
yAxisNameBorderRadius.description: Sets the y-axis (primary / secondary) border radius

yAxisNameBorderThickness.title: Y Axis Name Border Thickness
yAxisNameBorderThickness.description: Sets the y-axis (primary / secondary) border thickness

yAxisNameBorderDashed.title: Y Axis Name Border Dashed
yAxisNameBorderDashed.description:
Whether the border around the y-axis name should be rendered using dashed lines. 

__Default value__: 0 (border rendered using straight lines)

yAxisNameBorderDashLen.title: Y Axis Name Border Dash Len
yAxisNameBorderDashLen.description: Sets the length of each dash when the border around the y-axis name is rendered using dashed lines.

yAxisNameBorderDashGap.title: Y Axis Name Border Dash Gap
yAxisNameBorderDashGap.description: Sets the gap between two consecutive dashes when the border around the y-axis name is rendered using dashed lines.

showBorder.title: Show Border
showBorder.description: Whether to show a border around the chart or not.

drawFullAreaBorder.title: Draw Full Area Border
drawFullAreaBorder.description: If the `showPlotBorder` atrribute is set to `1`, set this  attribute to `0` to draw only the top border of the data plot.

bgColor.title: Bg Color
bgColor.description: This attribute sets the background color for the chart. You can set any hex color code as the value of this attribute. To specify a gradient as background color, separate the hex color codes of each color in the gradient using comma. Example: `#FF5904, #FFFFFF`.

bgAlpha.title: Bg Alpha
bgAlpha.description: Sets the alpha (transparency) for the background. If you've opted for gradient background, you need to set a list of alpha(s) separated by comma.

bgRatio.title: Bg Ratio
bgRatio.description: If you've opted for a gradient background, this attribute lets you set the ratio of each color constituent.

bgAngle.title: Bg Angle
bgAngle.description: Sets the angle of the background color, in case of a gradient.

bgImage.title: Bg Image
bgImage.description: To place any image (JPG/PNG/GIF) as background of the chart, enter the (path and) name of the background image. It should be in the same domain as the chart.

bgImageAlpha.title: Bg Image Alpha
bgImageAlpha.description: This attribute specifies the opacity for the loaded background image.

bgImageDisplayMode.title: Bg Image Display Mode
bgImageDisplayMode.description: Helps you specify the mode in which the background image is to be displayed. Stretch - expands the image to fit the entire chart area, without maintaining original image constraints. Tile - the image is repeated as a pattern on the entire chart area. Fit - fits the image proportionately on the chart area. Fill -proportionately fills the entire chart area with the image. Center - the image is positioned at the center of the chart area. None - Default mode.

bgImageVAlign.title: Bg Image V Align
bgImageVAlign.description: Helps you to vertically align the background image.

bgImageHAlign.title: Bg Image H Align
bgImageHAlign.description: Helps you to horizontally align the background image.

bgImageScale.title: Bg Image Scale
bgImageScale.description: Helps you magnify the background image.This attribute will only work when the attribute `bgImageDisplayMode` is set to none, center, or tile.

showcanvasborder.title: Showcanvasborder
showcanvasborder.description:
This attribute if set to _1_, shows a border around the canvas of the chart. 

__Default value__: 0

canvasBgColor.title: Canvas Bg Color
canvasBgColor.description: This attribute sets the background color for the chart canvas. You can set any hex color code as the value of this attribute. To specify a gradient as canvas background color, separate the hex color codes of each color in the gradient using comma. Example: #FF5904, #FFFFFF.

canvasBgAlpha.title: Canvas Bg Alpha
canvasBgAlpha.description: This attribute sets the background transparency for the chart canvas. For gradient, separate the alpha value using comma. Example: 15, 50.

canvasBgRatio.title: Canvas Bg Ratio
canvasBgRatio.description: When a gradient is used to set the color of the canvas background, this attribute sets the ratio of the colors. Example : If the value of the `canvasBgColor` attribute is set as `#FF5904, #FFFFFF`, `canvasBgRatio` can be used to specify their ratio in the background.

canvasBgAngle.title: Canvas Bg Angle
canvasBgAngle.description: Helps you specify canvas background angle in case of gradient.

canvasBorderColor.title: Canvas Border Color
canvasBorderColor.description: Lets you specify canvas border color.

canvasBorderThickness.title: Canvas Border Thickness
canvasBorderThickness.description: Lets you specify canvas border thickness.

canvasBorderAlpha.title: Canvas Border Alpha
canvasBorderAlpha.description: Lets you control transparency of canvas border.

showVLineLabelBorder.title: Show V Line Label Border
showVLineLabelBorder.description: If you've opted to show a label for any of your vLines in the chart, you can collectively configure whether to show border for all such labels using this attribute. If you want to show label border for just a particular vLine, you can over-ride this value by specifying border configuration for that specific vLine.

rotateVLineLabels.title: Rotate V Line Labels
rotateVLineLabels.description:
This attribute lets you set whether the vline labels will show up as rotated labels on the chart. 

Default value: 0

logoURL.title: Logo U R L
logoURL.description: You can load an external logo (JPEG/PNG) to your chart, this attribute lets you specify the URL. Due to cross domain security restrictions it is advised to use a logo from the same domain name as your charts.

logoLeftMargin.title: Logo Left Margin
logoLeftMargin.description: This attribute helps you set the amount of empty space that you want to put on the left side of your logo image. Nothing is rendered in this space.

logoTopMargin.title: Logo Top Margin
logoTopMargin.description: This attribute helps you set the amount of empty space that you want to put on top of your logo image. Nothing is rendered in this space.

logoPosition.title: Logo Position
logoPosition.description: Where to position the logo on the chart: TL - Top-left TR - Top-right BR - Bottom right BL - Bottom left CC - Center of screen

logoAlpha.title: Logo Alpha
logoAlpha.description: Once the logo has loaded on the chart, you can configure its opacity using this attribute.

logoScale.title: Logo Scale
logoScale.description: You can also change the scale of an externally loaded logo at run-time by specifying a value for this parameter.

logoLink.title: Logo Link
logoLink.description: If you want to link the logo to an external URL, specify the link in this attribute. The link can be in FusionCharts Link format, allowing you to link to new windows, pop-ups, frames etc.

useRoundEdges.title: Use Round Edges
useRoundEdges.description: If you wish to plot columns with round edges and fill them with a glass effect gradient, set this attribute to 1. The following functionalities will not work when this attribute is set to 1: `showShadow` attribute doesn't work any more. If you want to remove shadow from columns, you'll have to over-ride the shadow with a new shadow style (applied to DATAPLOT) with alpha as 0. Plot fill properties like gradient color, angle etc. will not work any more, as the colors for gradient are now calculated by the chart itself. Plot border properties also do not work in this mode. Also, you cannot render the border as dashed in this mode.

showPlotBorder.title: Show Plot Border
showPlotBorder.description: Whether the column, area, pie etc. border will show up. This attribute is used to show or hide the plot border and it is configurable at the chart instance, data plot, and data-series levels.

plotBorderColor.title: Plot Border Color
plotBorderColor.description: Color for column, area, pie border This attribute is used to specify the color for the plot border at the chart instance level.

plotBorderThickness.title: Plot Border Thickness
plotBorderThickness.description: Thickness for column, area, pie border This attribute is used to specify the thickness for the plot border at chart instance, data plot, and data-series levels.

plotBorderAlpha.title: Plot Border Alpha
plotBorderAlpha.description: Alpha for column, area, pie border This attribute is used to specify the opacity for the plot border at the chart instance level, data plot, and data-series levels.

plotBorderDashed.title: Plot Border Dashed
plotBorderDashed.description:
Whether the border around the data plots should be rendered using dashed lines. 

__Default value__: 0 (border rendered using straight lines)

plotBorderDashLen.title: Plot Border Dash Len
plotBorderDashLen.description: Sets the length of each dash when the border around the data plots are rendered using dashed lines.

plotBorderDashGap.title: Plot Border Dash Gap
plotBorderDashGap.description: Sets the gap between two consecutive dashes when the border around the data plots are rendered using dashed lines.

plotFillAngle.title: Plot Fill Angle
plotFillAngle.description: If you've opted to fill the plot (column, area etc.) as gradient, this attribute lets you set the fill angle for gradient.

plotFillAlpha.title: Plot Fill Alpha
plotFillAlpha.description: If you've opted to fill the plot (column, area etc.) as gradient, this attribute lets you set the fill alpha for gradient. If you've opted to fill the plot (column, area etc.) as gradient, this attribute lets you set the fill alpha for gradient.

plotGradientColor.title: Plot Gradient Color
plotGradientColor.description: You can globally add a gradient color to the entire plot of chart by specifying the second color as this attribute. For example, if you've specified individual colors for your dataplots and now you want a gradient that ends in white. You need to specify FFFFFF (white) as this color and the chart will now draw plots as gradient.

plotFillColor.title: Plot Fill Color
plotFillColor.description: Fill Color for the area (hex code)

usePlotGradientColor.title: Use Plot Gradient Color
usePlotGradientColor.description:
Gradient color is a color added globally to the entire plot of chart by specifying the second color in an attribute. This attribute sets the gradient color to _true_. 

__Default value__: 1

inheritPlotBorderColor.title: Inherit Plot Border Color
inheritPlotBorderColor.description: Set this attribute to `1` to inherit the data plot color of the area chart as the color of the data plot border.

valueFont.title: Value Font
valueFont.description: Sets the font of the values in the chart

valueFontSize.title: Value Font Size
valueFontSize.description: Specifies the value font size. Besides pixels (px) values can also be defined in rem, %, em, and vw.

valueFontBold.title: Value Font Bold
valueFontBold.description: Whether value font should be bold

valueFontItalic.title: Value Font Italic
valueFontItalic.description: Whether value font should be italicized

valueBgColor.title: Value Bg Color
valueBgColor.description: Sets the background color for value text

valueBorderColor.title: Value Border Color
valueBorderColor.description: Sets the border color around the value text

valueAlpha.title: Value Alpha
valueAlpha.description: Sets the value alpha including font and background

valueBorderPadding.title: Value Border Padding
valueBorderPadding.description: Sets the padding between the value and its surrounding border

valueBorderDashed.title: Value Border Dashed
valueBorderDashed.description:
Whether the border around the data values should be rendered using dashed lines. 

__Default value__: 0 (border rendered using straight lines)

valueBorderDashLen.title: Value Border Dash Len
valueBorderDashLen.description: Sets the length of each dash when the border around the data values is rendered using dashed lines.

valueBorderDashGap.title: Value Border Dash Gap
valueBorderDashGap.description: Sets the gap between two consecutive dashes when the border around the data values is rendered using dashed lines.

textOutline.title: Text Outline
textOutline.description:
Set this attribute to `1` to draw a border on the data value text. 

Default value: 0

yAxisValueFont.title: Y Axis Value Font
yAxisValueFont.description:
Set the font family for the Y-axis value texts. 

Default value: verdana,sans

yAxisValueFontColor.title: Y Axis Value Font Color
yAxisValueFontColor.description:
Sets the font color for the Y-axis value texts. 

Default value: #555555

yAxisValueFontSize.title: Y Axis Value Font Size
yAxisValueFontSize.description:
Sets the font size for the Y-axis value texts. 

Default value: 10 px. Besides pixels (px) values can also be defined in rem, %, em, and vw.

yAxisValueFontBold.title: Y Axis Value Font Bold
yAxisValueFontBold.description:
Displays the Y-axis value texts in bold. 

Default value: 0

yAxisValueFontItalic.title: Y Axis Value Font Italic
yAxisValueFontItalic.description:
Displays the Y-axis value texts in italic. 

Default value: 0

yAxisValueBgColor.title: Y Axis Value Bg Color
yAxisValueBgColor.description: Sets the background color for the Y-axis values.

yAxisValueBorderColor.title: Y Axis Value Border Color
yAxisValueBorderColor.description: Sets the border color for the Y-axis values.

yAxisValueAlpha.title: Y Axis Value Alpha
yAxisValueAlpha.description:
Sets the transparency for the Y-axis values between transparent (for `0`) and opaque (for `100`). 

Default value: 100

yAxisValueBgAlpha.title: Y Axis Value Bg Alpha
yAxisValueBgAlpha.description: Sets the transparency for the Y-axis value backgrounds between transparent (for `0`) and opaque (for `100`).

yAxisValueBorderAlpha.title: Y Axis Value Border Alpha
yAxisValueBorderAlpha.description: Sets the transparency for the Y-axis values between transparent (for `0`) and opaque (for `100`).

yAxisValueBorderPadding.title: Y Axis Value Border Padding
yAxisValueBorderPadding.description: Sets the border padding for the Y-axis values.

yAxisValueBorderRadius.title: Y Axis Value Border Radius
yAxisValueBorderRadius.description: Sets the border radius for the Y-axis values.

yAxisValueBorderThickness.title: Y Axis Value Border Thickness
yAxisValueBorderThickness.description: Sets the border thickness for the Y-axis values.

yAxisValueBorderDashed.title: Y Axis Value Border Dashed
yAxisValueBorderDashed.description:
Makes the Y-axis value borders dashed. 

Default value: 0 (border rendered using straight lines)

yAxisValueBorderDashLen.title: Y Axis Value Border Dash Len
yAxisValueBorderDashLen.description: Sets the lengths of the individual dashes when the Y-axis value borders are dashed.

yAxisValueBorderDashGap.title: Y Axis Value Border Dash Gap
yAxisValueBorderDashGap.description: Sets the gaps between individual dashes when the Y-axis value borders are dashed.

yAxisValueLink.title: Y Axis Value Link
yAxisValueLink.description: Sets a target link for all Y-axis values.

drawAnchors.title: Draw Anchors
drawAnchors.description: Whether to draw anchors on the chart.

anchorSides.title: Anchor Sides
anchorSides.description: This attribute sets the number of sides the anchor will have. For e.g., an anchor with 3 sides will represent a triangle, with 4 it will be a square and so on.

anchorStartAngle.title: Anchor Start Angle
anchorStartAngle.description:
This attribute sets the starting angle of anchors.  

Default value: 90

anchorRadius.title: Anchor Radius
anchorRadius.description: This attribute sets the radius (in pixels) of the anchor.

anchorBorderColor.title: Anchor Border Color
anchorBorderColor.description: Lets you set the border color of anchors.

anchorBorderThickness.title: Anchor Border Thickness
anchorBorderThickness.description: Helps you set border thickness of anchors.

anchorBgColor.title: Anchor Bg Color
anchorBgColor.description: Helps you set the background color of anchors.

anchorAlpha.title: Anchor Alpha
anchorAlpha.description: Helps you set the alpha of entire anchors. If you need to hide the anchors on chart but still enable tool tips, set this as 0.

anchorBgAlpha.title: Anchor Bg Alpha
anchorBgAlpha.description: Helps you set the alpha of anchor background.

anchorImageUrl.title: Anchor Image Url
anchorImageUrl.description:
If you want to use an external image (JPG/PNG) as an anchor,  this attribute lets you specify the URL. 

__Note__: Due to cross domain security restrictions it is advised to use an image from the same domain name as your charts.

anchorImageAlpha.title: Anchor Image Alpha
anchorImageAlpha.description:
This attribute allows to set a transparency for images displayed as anchors in charts. 

__Default value__: 100

anchorImageScale.title: Anchor Image Scale
anchorImageScale.description:
This attribute allows to set a scale for magnifying images displayed as anchors. 

 __Default value__: 100

anchorImagePadding.title: Anchor Image Padding
anchorImagePadding.description:
This attribute sets the padding between the anchor image and the border of the anchor. For the anchor image, instead of decreasing the size of the image this attribute crops the image.  

Default value: 1

numDivLines.title: Num Div Lines
numDivLines.description: Number of horizontal axis division lines that you want on the chart.

divLineDashed.title: Div Line Dashed
divLineDashed.description:
Whether the divisional lines should be rendered as dashed lines. 

__Default value__: 0 (divisional lines rendered using straight lines)

divLineDashLen.title: Div Line Dash Len
divLineDashLen.description: Sets the length of each dash when divisional lines are rendered as dashed lines.

divLineDashGap.title: Div Line Dash Gap
divLineDashGap.description: Sets the gap between two consecutive dashes when divisional lines are rendered as dashed lines.

zeroPlaneColor.title: Zero Plane Color
zeroPlaneColor.description: Color for the Zero Plane. Zero Plane is the line/plane that appears at position 0 on the y-axis, when negative data is being shown on the chart.

showZeroPlaneValue.title: Show Zero Plane Value
showZeroPlaneValue.description: Allows you to show or hide the value on which the zero plane exists on the y-axis. By default, the value is displayed.

showAlternateHGridColor.title: Show Alternate H Grid Color
showAlternateHGridColor.description: Whether to show alternate colored horizontal grid bands.

alternateHGridColor.title: Alternate H Grid Color
alternateHGridColor.description: Color of the alternate horizontal grid bands.

alternateHGridAlpha.title: Alternate H Grid Alpha
alternateHGridAlpha.description: Alpha (transparency) of the alternate horizontal grid bands.

numVDivLines.title: Num V Div Lines
numVDivLines.description: Number of vertical axis division lines

vDivLineColor.title: V Div Line Color
vDivLineColor.description: Color of vertical axis division lines.

vDivLineThickness.title: V Div Line Thickness
vDivLineThickness.description: Thickness of vertical axis division lines.

vDivLineAlpha.title: V Div Line Alpha
vDivLineAlpha.description: Alpha of vertical axis division lines.

vDivLineDashed.title: V Div Line Dashed
vDivLineDashed.description:
Whether the vertical divisional lines should be rendered as dashed lines. 

__Default value__: 0 (vertical divisional lines using straight lines)

vDivLineDashLen.title: V Div Line Dash Len
vDivLineDashLen.description: Sets the width of each dash when vertical divisional lines are rendered as dashed lines.

vDivLineDashGap.title: V Div Line Dash Gap
vDivLineDashGap.description: Sets the gap between two consecutive dashes when vertical divisional lines are rendered as dashed lines.

showAlternateVGridColor.title: Show Alternate V Grid Color
showAlternateVGridColor.description: Whether to show alternate vertical colored grid bands.

alternateVGridColor.title: Alternate V Grid Color
alternateVGridColor.description: Color of alternate vertical colored grid bands.

alternateVGridAlpha.title: Alternate V Grid Alpha
alternateVGridAlpha.description: Alpha of alternate vertical colored grid bands.

showLegend.title: Show Legend
showLegend.description: Whether to show legend on the chart.

legendItemFontBold.title: Legend Item Font Bold
legendItemFontBold.description: Whether legend keys should be displayed in bold

legendItemHoverFontColor.title: Legend Item Hover Font Color
legendItemHoverFontColor.description: Sets legend item font color on hover

legendPosition.title: Legend Position
legendPosition.description: The legend can be plotted at different positions with respect to the chart. Note that if the value of `legendPosition` is set to `absolute`, you also need to set the coordinates of the legend. You can do that using the attributes `legendXPosition` and `legendYPosition`, both of which accept absolute or percentage values.

legendXPosition.title: Legend X Position
legendXPosition.description: When the value of `legendPosition` is set to `absolute`, use this attribute to set the X-coordinate of the legend. It accepts absolute or percentage values. By default, its value is set to `0`.

legendYPosition.title: Legend Y Position
legendYPosition.description: When the value of `legendPosition` is set to `absolute`, use this attribute to set the Y-coordinate of the legend. It accepts absolute or percentage values. By default, its value is set to `0`.

legendNumRows.title: Legend Num Rows
legendNumRows.description: Sets the number of rows the legend should display.

legendNumColumns.title: Legend Num Columns
legendNumColumns.description: If your chart contains multiple series, the legend is displayed as a grid comprising of multiple legend keys. With the help of this attribute you can specify the number of columns that are to be displayed in the legend.

legendCaptionAlignment.title: Legend Caption Alignment
legendCaptionAlignment.description: Sets the legend caption horizontal alignment .

legendCaptionFontBold.title: Legend Caption Font Bold
legendCaptionFontBold.description: Whether legend caption should be displayed in bold

legendCaption.title: Legend Caption
legendCaption.description: You can add a caption for the entire legend by setting the same here.

legendItemHiddenColor.title: Legend Item Hidden Color
legendItemHiddenColor.description: Sets the color that applies on both text font and icon when they are in a  disabled / hidden state

legendIconScale.title: Legend Icon Scale
legendIconScale.description: Scaling of legend icon is possible in FusionCharts XT. This attribute lets you control the size of legend icon.

legendShadow.title: Legend Shadow
legendShadow.description: Whether to show a shadow for legend.

legendAllowDrag.title: Legend Allow Drag
legendAllowDrag.description: The legend can be made drag-able by setting this attribute to 1. End viewers of the chart can drag the legend around on the chart.

legendScrollBgColor.title: Legend Scroll Bg Color
legendScrollBgColor.description: If you've too many items on the legend, a scroll bar shows up on the same. This attribute lets you configure the background color of the scroll bar.

reverseLegend.title: Reverse Legend
reverseLegend.description: You can reverse the ordering of datasets in the legend by setting this attribute to 1.

interactiveLegend.title: Interactive Legend
interactiveLegend.description: This attribute lets you interact with the legend in your chart. When you click a legend key, the dataplots associated with that series are eliminated from the chart. Re-clicking the key causes the dataplots to reappear.

minimiseWrappingInLegend.title: Minimise Wrapping In Legend
minimiseWrappingInLegend.description: Whether to minimize legend item text wrapping.

drawCustomLegendIcon.title: Draw Custom Legend Icon
drawCustomLegendIcon.description:
Specifies whether drawing a custom legend icon will be enabled. All legend icon customization attributes will work only if this feature is enabled. 

Default value: 0 (disabled)

legendIconBorderColor.title: Legend Icon Border Color
legendIconBorderColor.description:
Sets the border color for the legend icon. 

Default value: Data plot border color

legendIconBgColor.title: Legend Icon Bg Color
legendIconBgColor.description:
Sets the background color for the legend icon. 

Default value: Data plot fill color

legendIconAlpha.title: Legend Icon Alpha
legendIconAlpha.description:
Sets the legend icon transparency. 

Default value: 100

legendIconBgAlpha.title: Legend Icon Bg Alpha
legendIconBgAlpha.description:
Sets the legend icon background transparency. 

Default value: 100

legendIconSides.title: Legend Icon Sides
legendIconSides.description:
Sets the number of sides for the legend icon. 

Default value: 4

legendIconBorderThickness.title: Legend Icon Border Thickness
legendIconBorderThickness.description:
Sets the thickness of the legend icon border. 

Default value: 1

legendIconStartAngle.title: Legend Icon Start Angle
legendIconStartAngle.description:
Sets the starting angle of for drawing the legend icon. 

Default value: 45

alignLegendWithCanvas.title: Align Legend With Canvas
alignLegendWithCanvas.description: This attribute if set to `0`, the legend box will be center aligned with respect to the entire width of the chart only if the total width of the legend box is more than the canvas width. By default, the legend box is center aligned with respect to the canvas width and it remains the same if the width of the legend box is less than the canvas width.

formatNumber.title: Format Number
formatNumber.description: This configuration determines whether the numbers displayed on the chart will be formatted using commas, e.g., 40,000 if 'formatNumber': '1'; and 40000 if 'formatNumber': '0';.

formatNumberScale.title: Format Number Scale
formatNumberScale.description: Configuration whether to add K (thousands) and M (millions) to a number after truncating and rounding it - e.g., if `formatNumberScale` is set to 1, 1043 will become 1.04K (with decimals set to 2 places). Same with numbers in millions - an M will be added at the end.

defaultNumberScale.title: Default Number Scale
defaultNumberScale.description: The default unit of the numbers that you're providing to the chart.

numberScaleUnit.title: Number Scale Unit
numberScaleUnit.description: Unit of each block of the scale.

numberScaleValue.title: Number Scale Value
numberScaleValue.description: Range of the various blocks that constitute the scale.

forceNumberScale.title: Force Number Scale
forceNumberScale.description:
If a data value is less than the lowest given number is the number scale, this attribute forces the lower value of the  `numberScaleUnit` to be applied to that data value.  This attribute works only when `“formatNumberScale”: “1”` and the `defaultNumberScale` attribute is not defined. 

For example, if `“numberScaleUnit”: “K, M”`, `“numberScaleValue”: “1000, 1000”`, and `“forceNumberScale”: “1”`, a data value of __400__ will be rendered as __0.40K__.

scaleRecursively.title: Scale Recursively
scaleRecursively.description: Whether recursive scaling should be applied.

maxScaleRecursion.title: Max Scale Recursion
maxScaleRecursion.description: How many recursions to complete during recursive scaling? -1 completes the entire set of recursion.

scaleSeparator.title: Scale Separator
scaleSeparator.description: What character to use to separate the scales that are generated after recursion?

numberPrefix.title: Number Prefix
numberPrefix.description: Using this attribute, you could add prefix to all the numbers visible on the graph. For example, to represent all dollars figure on the chart, you could specify this attribute to $ to show like $40000, $50000.

numberSuffix.title: Number Suffix
numberSuffix.description: Using this attribute, you could add a suffix to all the numbers visible on the graph. For example, to represent all figures quantified as per annum on the chart, you could specify this attribute to '/a' to show like 40000/a, 50000/a.

decimalSeparator.title: Decimal Separator
decimalSeparator.description: This attribute helps you specify the character to be used as the decimal separator in a number.

thousandSeparator.title: Thousand Separator
thousandSeparator.description: This attribute helps you specify the character to be used as the thousands separator in a number.

thousandSeparatorPosition.title: Thousand Separator Position
thousandSeparatorPosition.description: This option helps you specify the position of the thousand separator.

inDecimalSeparator.title: In Decimal Separator
inDecimalSeparator.description: In some countries, commas are used as decimal separators and dots as thousand separators. In XML, if you specify such values, it will give an error while converting to number. So, FusionCharts XT accepts the input decimal and thousand separator from user, so that it can convert it accordingly into the required format. This attribute lets you input the decimal separator.

inThousandSeparator.title: In Thousand Separator
inThousandSeparator.description: In some countries, commas are used as decimal separators and dots as thousand separators. In XML, if you specify such values, it will give an error while converting to number. So, FusionCharts XT accepts the input decimal and thousand separator from user, so that it can convert it accordingly into the required format. This attribute lets you input the thousand separator.

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: Number of decimal places to which all numbers on the chart will be rounded to.

forceDecimals.title: Force Decimals
forceDecimals.description: Whether to add 0 padding at the end of decimal numbers. For example, If you limit the maximum number of decimal digits to 2, a number like 55.345 will be rounded to 55.34. This does not mean that all numbers will be displayed with a fixed number of decimal places. For instance 55 will not be displayed as 55.00 and 55.1 will not become 55.10. In order to have fixed number of decimal places attached to all the numbers, set this attribute to 1.

baseFont.title: Base Font
baseFont.description: This attribute lets you set the font face (family) of all the text (data labels, values etc.) on chart. If you specify the `outCnvBaseFont` attribute also, then this attribute controls only the font face of text within the chart canvas bounds.

baseFontSize.title: Base Font Size
baseFontSize.description: This attribute sets the base font size of the chart i.e., all the values and the names in the chart which lie on the canvas will be displayed using the font size provided here. Besides pixels (px) values can also be defined in rem, %, em, and vw.

baseFontColor.title: Base Font Color
baseFontColor.description: This attribute sets the base font color of the chart i.e., all the values and the names in the chart which lie on the canvas will be displayed using the font color provided here.

outCnvBaseFont.title: Out Cnv Base Font
outCnvBaseFont.description: This attribute sets the base font family of the chart text which lies outside the canvas i.e., all the values and the names in the chart which lie outside the canvas will be displayed using the font name provided here.

outCnvBaseFontSize.title: Out Cnv Base Font Size
outCnvBaseFontSize.description: This attribute sets the base font size of the chart i.e., all the values and the names in the chart which lie outside the canvas will be displayed using the font size provided here. Besides pixels (px) values can also be defined in rem, %, em, and vw.

outCnvBaseFontColor.title: Out Cnv Base Font Color
outCnvBaseFontColor.description: This attribute sets the base font color of the chart i.e., all the values and the names in the chart which lie outside the canvas will be displayed using the font color provided here.

labelFont.title: Label Font
labelFont.description: Sets the x-axis label font family for the text.

labelFontColor.title: Label Font Color
labelFontColor.description: Sets the x-axis label font color.

labelFontSize.title: Label Font Size
labelFontSize.description: Specifies the x-axis label font size. Besides pixels (px) values can also be defined in rem, %, em, and vw.

labelFontBold.title: Label Font Bold
labelFontBold.description: Flag indicating whether x-axis label font should be bold or not.

labelFontItalic.title: Label Font Italic
labelFontItalic.description: Flag indicating whether x-axis label font should be italicized or not.

labelBgColor.title: Label Bg Color
labelBgColor.description: Sets the background color for x-axis label text.

labelBorderColor.title: Label Border Color
labelBorderColor.description: Sets the color of the border around the x-axis label text.

labelAlpha.title: Label Alpha
labelAlpha.description: Sets the x-axis label alpha for both font and background.

labelBgAlpha.title: Label Bg Alpha
labelBgAlpha.description: Sets the x-axis label background alpha.

labelBorderAlpha.title: Label Border Alpha
labelBorderAlpha.description: Sets the x-axis label border alpha.

labelBorderPadding.title: Label Border Padding
labelBorderPadding.description: Sets the x-axis label border padding.

labelBorderRadius.title: Label Border Radius
labelBorderRadius.description: Sets the x-axis label border radius.

labelBorderThickness.title: Label Border Thickness
labelBorderThickness.description: Sets the x-axis label border thickness.

labelBorderDashed.title: Label Border Dashed
labelBorderDashed.description:
Whether the border around x-axis labels should be rendered using dashed lines. 

__Default value__: 0 (border rendered using straight lines)

labelBorderDashLen.title: Label Border Dash Len
labelBorderDashLen.description: Sets the length of each dash when the border around the x-axis labels are rendered using dashed lines.

labelBorderDashGap.title: Label Border Dash Gap
labelBorderDashGap.description: Sets the gap between two consecutive dashes when the border around x-axis labels are rendered using dashed lines.

labelLink.title: Label Link
labelLink.description: Sets a link for all x-axis labels.

drawCrossLine.title: Draw Cross Line
drawCrossLine.description:
This attribute sets a cross line (vertical line/area), when you hover a data plot. 

Default value: __0__

crossLineColor.title: Cross Line Color
crossLineColor.description:
This attribute sets the color of the cross line. 

Default value: __#EEEEEE__

crossLineAlpha.title: Cross Line Alpha
crossLineAlpha.description:
This attribute sets the opacity of the cross line. 

Default value: __50__

crossLineAnimation.title: Cross Line Animation
crossLineAnimation.description:
This attributes enables the animation for the cross line. 

Default value: __0__

crossLineAnimationDuration.title: Cross Line Animation Duration
crossLineAnimationDuration.description:
This attribute sets the animation duration of the cross line. 

Default value: __0.09 seconds__

plotColorinTooltip.title: Plot Colorin Tooltip
plotColorinTooltip.description:
This attribute displays the color of each plot with their labels in tooltip. 

Default value: __1__

tooltipGrayoutColor.title: Tooltip Grayout Color
tooltipGrayoutColor.description:
This attribute sets the color of the unfocused plot in the tooltip for multi-series chart. By default it is set as gray. 

Default value: __#AAAAAA__

drawCrossLineOnTop.title: Draw Cross Line On Top
drawCrossLineOnTop.description:
This attribute is used to determine if the cross line will be drawn above the data plot or below the data plot. 

Default value: __0__

showToolTip.title: Show Tool Tip
showToolTip.description: Whether to show tool tip on chart.

tooltipBorderAlpha.title: Tooltip Border Alpha
tooltipBorderAlpha.description: Sets the border transparency for tool tip.

toolTipSepChar.title: Tool Tip Sep Char
toolTipSepChar.description: The character specified as the value of this attribute separates the name and value displayed in tool tip.

seriesNameInToolTip.title: Series Name In Tool Tip
seriesNameInToolTip.description: For multi-series charts, FusionCharts XT shows the following information in tool tip (unless tool text is explicitly defined): "Series Name, Category Name, Data Value". This attribute lets you control whether series name will show up in tool tip or not.

showToolTipShadow.title: Show Tool Tip Shadow
showToolTipShadow.description: Whether to show shadow for tool-tips on the chart.

tooltipbgalpha.title: Tooltipbgalpha
tooltipbgalpha.description: Sets the transparency of the tooltip.

tooltipborderradius.title: Tooltipborderradius
tooltipborderradius.description: Sets the border radius of the tooltip.

tooltipborderthickness.title: Tooltipborderthickness
tooltipborderthickness.description: Sets the border thickness of the tooltip.

toolTipPadding.title: Tool Tip Padding
toolTipPadding.description: This attribute sets the vertical space between the value and the border of the tooltip. If you want more space between the value and the border, you can use this attribute to control it.

plottooltext.title: Plottooltext
plottooltext.description:
Specify custom text for the tooltip 

 You can either specify a constant string as the tooltip text or you can use variable values from the data level by prefixing a __$__ to the attribute name, for example, __$name__, __$value__.

toolbarPosition.title: Toolbar Position
toolbarPosition.description: Where to position the toolbar on the chart: TL - Top-left TR - Top-right BR - Bottom right BL - Bottom left CC - Center of screen

toolbarX.title: Toolbar X
toolbarX.description: Sets the toolbox position on the chart with respect to x-axis.

toolbarY.title: Toolbar Y
toolbarY.description: Sets the toolbox position on the chart with respect to y-axis.

toolbarHAlign.title: Toolbar H Align
toolbarHAlign.description: Sets the horizontal alignment of the toolbar on the chart.

toolbarVAlign.title: Toolbar V Align
toolbarVAlign.description: Sets the vertical alignment of the toolbar on the chart

toolbarButtonColor.title: Toolbar Button Color
toolbarButtonColor.description: Sets the color of the toolbar buttons.

showToolBarButtonTooltext.title: Show Tool Bar Button Tooltext
showToolBarButtonTooltext.description: Enables/disables display of tooltips for toolbar buttons.

toolbarButtonScale.title: Toolbar Button Scale
toolbarButtonScale.description: You can change the scale of the toolbar by specifying a value for this attribute.

exportEnabled.title: Export Enabled
exportEnabled.description:
Whether the chart will allow exporting to images, PDFs, SVG, XLSX or CSV format.  

__Default value__: 0

exportAction.title: Export Action
exportAction.description:
In case of server-side exporting, the action specifies whether the exported image will be sent back to client as download, or whether it'll be saved on the server. 

__Default value__: download

exportHandler.title: Export Handler
exportHandler.description: In case of server side exporting, this refers to the path of the server-side export handler (the ready-to-use scripts that we provide).

exportFormats.title: Export Formats
exportFormats.description: Lets you configure what output formats to allow for export of chart, in the export context menu, and also customize the label for each menu item. The attribute value should be a pipe (|) delimited separated key-value pair. Example: `exportFormats: 'PNG=Export as High Quality Image|JPG|PDF=Export as PDF File'`

exportMode.title: Export Mode
exportMode.description:
This attributes sets the modes of export. To enable client-side exporting, set this attribute to __client__. 

__Default value__: auto. 

__Note__: Starting v3.12.1, the `exportMode` attribute replaces the `exportAtClientSide` attribute. However, you don’t need to make any changes to the existing setup because, the FusionCharts library comes with the proper mapping already provided.

exportShowMenuItem.title: Export Show Menu Item
exportShowMenuItem.description: Whether the menu items related to export (e.g., Save as JPEG etc.) will appear in the context menu of chart.

exportTargetWindow.title: Export Target Window
exportTargetWindow.description:
In case of server-side exporting and when using download as action, this lefts you configure whether the return image, PDF, SVG or XLSX will open in same window (as an attachment for download), or whether it will open in a new window. 

__Default value__: _self

exportFileName.title: Export File Name
exportFileName.description: Using this attribute you can specify the name (excluding the extension) of the output (export) file.

showHoverEffect.title: Show Hover Effect
showHoverEffect.description: Whether to enable hover effect on charts for all elements

anchorHoverEffect.title: Anchor Hover Effect
anchorHoverEffect.description: Sets whether to enable the hover effect on charts for anchors.

anchorHoverColor.title: Anchor Hover Color
anchorHoverColor.description: This attribute sets the hover color for anchors.

anchorHoverAlpha.title: Anchor Hover Alpha
anchorHoverAlpha.description: This attribute specifies the transparency for the anchors when hovered.

anchorHoverSides.title: Anchor Hover Sides
anchorHoverSides.description: This attribute sets the number of sides of the anchor when hovered.

anchorHoverRadius.title: Anchor Hover Radius
anchorHoverRadius.description: This attribute sets the radius of the anchor when hovered.

anchorBgHoverColor.title: Anchor Bg Hover Color
anchorBgHoverColor.description: This attribute sets the background color of anchor when hovered.

anchorBgHoverAlpha.title: Anchor Bg Hover Alpha
anchorBgHoverAlpha.description: This attribute sets the transparency of anchor’s background when hovered.

anchorBorderHoverColor.title: Anchor Border Hover Color
anchorBorderHoverColor.description: Sets the border color of anchors when hovered.

anchorBorderHoverAlpha.title: Anchor Border Hover Alpha
anchorBorderHoverAlpha.description: Sets the border's transparency of anchors when hovered.

anchorBorderHoverThickness.title: Anchor Border Hover Thickness
anchorBorderHoverThickness.description: This attribute sets the border thickness of the anchors when hovered.

anchorHoverStartAngle.title: Anchor Hover Start Angle
anchorHoverStartAngle.description: This attribute sets the starting angle of the anchors when hovered.

anchorHoverDip.title: Anchor Hover Dip
anchorHoverDip.description:
This attribute adds a dip effect (different shapes) to the anchors on hover. When hovered a star shaped anchor is created. Using `anchorSides` attribute, you can specify the no. of sides for anchors. 
`Note : If the anchors are of circular shape, this attribute won't be applied on it.`

anchorHoverAnimation.title: Anchor Hover Animation
anchorHoverAnimation.description:
Anchors get animated when the normal radius and the hover radius are different. To disable this effect you can set anchorHoverAnimation = `0`. 

Default value: `1`

captionPadding.title: Caption Padding
captionPadding.description: This attribute lets you control the space (in pixels) between the sub-caption and top of the chart canvas. If the sub-caption is not defined, it controls the space between caption and top of chart canvas. If neither caption, nor sub-caption is defined, this padding does not come into play.

xAxisNamePadding.title: X Axis Name Padding
xAxisNamePadding.description: Using this, you can set the distance between the top end of x-axis title and the bottom end of data labels (or canvas, if data labels are not to be shown).

yAxisNamePadding.title: Y Axis Name Padding
yAxisNamePadding.description: Using this, you can set the distance between the right end of y-axis title and the start of y-axis values (or canvas, if the y-axis values are not to be shown).

yAxisValuesPadding.title: Y Axis Values Padding
yAxisValuesPadding.description: This attribute helps you set the horizontal space between the canvas left edge and the y-axis values or trend line values (on left/right side). This is particularly useful, when you want more space between your canvas and y-axis values.

labelPadding.title: Label Padding
labelPadding.description: This attribute sets the vertical space between the labels and canvas bottom edge. If you want more space between the canvas and the x-axis labels, you can use this attribute to control it.

valuePadding.title: Value Padding
valuePadding.description: It sets the vertical space between the end of columns and start of value textboxes. This basically helps you control the space you want between your columns/anchors and the value textboxes.

chartLeftMargin.title: Chart Left Margin
chartLeftMargin.description: Amount of empty space that you want to put on the left side of your chart. Nothing is rendered in this space.

chartRightMargin.title: Chart Right Margin
chartRightMargin.description: Amount of empty space that you want to put on the right side of your chart. Nothing is rendered in this space.

chartTopMargin.title: Chart Top Margin
chartTopMargin.description: Amount of empty space that you want to put on the top of your chart. Nothing is rendered in this space.

chartBottomMargin.title: Chart Bottom Margin
chartBottomMargin.description: Amount of empty space that you want to put at the bottom of your chart. Nothing is rendered in this space.

canvasPadding.title: Canvas Padding
canvasPadding.description: Lets you set the space between the canvas border and first & last data points

canvasLeftPadding.title: Canvas Left Padding
canvasLeftPadding.description: This attribute lets you set the space between the left of the canvas border and the canvas of the chart. This attribute is particularly useful when your data plot gets clipped by the left border of the canvas. Using this attribute, you can control the amount of empty space between the chart left side and data plot which might get clipped.

canvasRightPadding.title: Canvas Right Padding
canvasRightPadding.description: This attribute lets you set the space between the right of the canvas border and the canvas  of the chart. This attribute is particularly useful when your data plot gets clipped by the right border of the canvas. Using this attribute, you can control the amount of empty space between the chart right side and data plot which might get clipped.

canvasTopPadding.title: Canvas Top Padding
canvasTopPadding.description: This attribute lets you set the space between the top of the canvas border and the canvas of the chart. This attribute is particularly useful when your data plot gets clipped by the top border of the canvas. Using this attribute, you can control the amount of empty space between the chart's top and data plot which might get clipped.

canvasBottomPadding.title: Canvas Bottom Padding
canvasBottomPadding.description: This attribute lets you set the space between the bottom of the canvas border and the canvas of the chart. This attribute is particularly useful when your data plot gets clipped by the bottom border of the canvas. Using this attribute, you can control the amount of empty space between the chart's bottom and data plot which might get clipped.

legendPadding.title: Legend Padding
legendPadding.description: Padding of legend from right/bottom side of canvas

canvasLeftMargin.title: Canvas Left Margin
canvasLeftMargin.description: This attribute lets you control the space between the start of chart canvas and the start (x) of chart. In case of 2D charts, the canvas is the visible rectangular box. In case of 3D charts, the canvas box is the imaginary box around the 3D canvas. Using this attribute, you can control the amount of empty space between the chart left side and canvas left side. By default, FusionCharts XT automatically calculates this space depending on the elements to be placed on the chart. However, if you want to over-ride this value with a higher value, you can use this attribute to specify the same. Please note that you cannot specify a margin lower than what has been calculated by the chart. This attribute is particularly useful, when you've multiple charts placed in a page and want all their canvas start position to align with each other - so in such a case, you can set same margin value (a value large enough that it doesn't get rejected by chart owing to it being lower than the calculated value) for all such charts in the page.

canvasRightMargin.title: Canvas Right Margin
canvasRightMargin.description: Like `canvasLeftMargin`, this attribute lets you set the space between end of canvas and end of chart.

canvasTopMargin.title: Canvas Top Margin
canvasTopMargin.description: Like `canvasLeftMargin`, this attribute lets you set the space between top of canvas and top of chart.

canvasBottomMargin.title: Canvas Bottom Margin
canvasBottomMargin.description: Like `canvasLeftMargin`, this attribute lets you set the space between bottom of canvas and bottom of chart.

trendlineColor.title: Trendline Color
trendlineColor.description: Sets color of all the trend lines and its associated text in the chart.

trendlineThickness.title: Trendline Thickness
trendlineThickness.description: If you've opted to show the trend as a line, this attribute lets you define the thickness of all the trend lines in your chart.

trendlineAlpha.title: Trendline Alpha
trendlineAlpha.description: Sets transparency for all the trend lines in your charts.

trendLineToolText.title: Trend Line Tool Text
trendLineToolText.description: Sets the tooltip text of the trend-line. It accepts macros, plain text, and HTML tags, as string.

showTrendlinesOnTop.title: Show Trendlines On Top
showTrendlinesOnTop.description: Whether all the trend line/zone will be displayed over data plots or under them.

trendValueFont.title: Trend Value Font
trendValueFont.description: Sets the font family for the trend-line display value.

trendValueFontSize.title: Trend Value Font Size
trendValueFontSize.description: Sets the font size for the trend-line display value. Besides pixels (px) values can also be defined in rem, %, em, and vw.

trendValueFontBold.title: Trend Value Font Bold
trendValueFontBold.description:
Sets whether the trend-line display value will be bold formatted. 

Default value: 0 (not bold formatted)

trendValueFontItalic.title: Trend Value Font Italic
trendValueFontItalic.description:
Sets whether the trend-line display value will be italicized. 

Default value: 0 (not italicized)

trendValueBgColor.title: Trend Value Bg Color
trendValueBgColor.description: Sets the background color for the trend-line display value.

trendValueBorderColor.title: Trend Value Border Color
trendValueBorderColor.description: Sets the border color for the trend-line display value.

trendValueAlpha.title: Trend Value Alpha
trendValueAlpha.description:
Sets the transparency for the trend-line display value. 

Default value: 100

trendValueBgAlpha.title: Trend Value Bg Alpha
trendValueBgAlpha.description:
Sets the transparency for the background of the trend-line display value. 

Default value: 100

trendValueBorderAlpha.title: Trend Value Border Alpha
trendValueBorderAlpha.description:
Sets the transparency for the border around the trend-line display value. 

Default value: 100

trendValueBorderPadding.title: Trend Value Border Padding
trendValueBorderPadding.description: Sets padding for the border around the trend-line display value.

trendValueBorderRadius.title: Trend Value Border Radius
trendValueBorderRadius.description: Sets the radius for the border around the trend-line display value.

trendValueBorderThickness.title: Trend Value Border Thickness
trendValueBorderThickness.description: Sets the thickness for the border around the trend-line display value.

trendValueBorderDashed.title: Trend Value Border Dashed
trendValueBorderDashed.description:
Whether the border around the trend-line display value should be rendered as dashed lines. 

__Default value__: 0 (border rendered using straight lines)

trendValueBorderDashLen.title: Trend Value Border Dash Len
trendValueBorderDashLen.description: Sets the length of each dash when the border around the trend-line display value is rendered as dashed lines.

trendValueBorderDashGap.title: Trend Value Border Dash Gap
trendValueBorderDashGap.description: Sets the gap between two consecutive dashes when the border around the trend-line display value is rendered as dashed lines.

label.title: Label
label.description:
This attribute determines the label for the data item. The label appears on the x-axis of chart.

 __Note__: The `label` attribute replaces the `name` attribute. Previously, either one of the attributes could be used to set the label. Support for the `name` attribute has been discontinued since v3.10.0.

showLabel.title: Show Label
showLabel.description: You can individually opt to show/hide labels of individual data items using this attribute.

toolText.title: Tool Text
toolText.description: The tooltip defined in the `category` object appears only when the mouse cursor is hovered over the data plots. However, this will not appear when the cursor is moved over the data labels (except for a situation when long labels are automatically truncated with ellipses. In this situation, if the mouse cursor is hovered over a truncated label, the tooltip will appear with the full label). In case you want to set a short label and show the full label in tooltip, define the full label using this attribute within the `category` object. The tooltip with the full label will appear only when the mouse is hovered on the dataplot.

font.title: Font
font.description: Sets the x-axis label font family for the text.

fontColor.title: Font Color
fontColor.description: Sets the x-axis label font color.

fontSize.title: Font Size
fontSize.description: Specifies the x-axis label font size. Besides pixels (px) values can also be defined in rem, %, em, and vw.

fontBold.title: Font Bold
fontBold.description: Flag indicating whether x-axis label font should be bold or not.

fontItalic.title: Font Italic
fontItalic.description: Flag indicating whether x-axis label font should be italicized or not.

bgColor.title: Bg Color
bgColor.description: Sets the background color for x-axis label text.

borderColor.title: Border Color
borderColor.description: Sets the color of the border around the x-axis label text.

alpha.title: Alpha
alpha.description: Sets the x-axis label alpha for both font and background.

bgAlpha.title: Bg Alpha
bgAlpha.description: Sets the x-axis label background alpha.

borderAlpha.title: Border Alpha
borderAlpha.description: Sets the x-axis label border alpha.

borderPadding.title: Border Padding
borderPadding.description: Sets the x-axis label border padding.

borderRadius.title: Border Radius
borderRadius.description: Sets the x-axis label border radius.

borderThickness.title: Border Thickness
borderThickness.description: Sets the x-axis label border thickness.

borderDashed.title: Border Dashed
borderDashed.description:
Whether the border around x-axis label should be rendered using dashed lines. 

__Default value__: 0 (border rendered using straight lines)

borderDashLen.title: Border Dash Len
borderDashLen.description: Sets the length of each dash when the border around the x-axis label is rendered using dashed lines.

borderDashGap.title: Border Dash Gap
borderDashGap.description: Sets the gap between two consecutive dashes when the border around x-axis label is rendered using dashed lines.

vLine.title: V Line
vLine.description: Set this attribute to __true__ to render a vertical data separator line.

color.title: Color
color.description: This attribute defines the color of vertical separator line

thickness.title: Thickness
thickness.description: Thickness in pixels of the vertical separator line.

alpha.title: Alpha
alpha.description: Alpha of the vertical separator line.

dashed.title: Dashed
dashed.description:
Whether the vertical separator line should be rendered as dashed lines. 

__Default value__: 0 (vertical separator line rendered using straight lines)

dashLen.title: Dash Len
dashLen.description: Sets the width of each dash when vertical separator line is rendered as dashed lines.

dashGap.title: Dash Gap
dashGap.description: Sets the gap between consecutive dashes when vertical separator line is rendered as dashed lines.

label.title: Label
label.description:
Label for the vertical separator line, if to be shown. 

 __Note__: The `label` attribute replaces the `name` attribute. Previously, either one of the attributes could be used to set the label. Support for the `name` attribute has been discontinued since v3.10.0.

showLabelBorder.title: Show Label Border
showLabelBorder.description: Whether to show a border around the vLine label.

linePosition.title: Line Position
linePosition.description: Helps configure the position of vertical line i.e., if a vLine is to be plotted between 2 points Jan and Feb, user can set any position between 0 and 1 to indicate the relative position of vLine between these two points (0 means Jan and 1 means Feb). By default, it’s 0.5 to show in between the points.

labelPosition.title: Label Position
labelPosition.description: Helps configure the position of the vLine label by setting a relative position between 0 and 1. In vertical charts, 0 means top of canvas and 1 means bottom. In horizontal charts, 0 means left of canvas and 1 means right.

labelHAlign.title: Label H Align
labelHAlign.description: Horizontal anchor point for the alignment of vLine label.

labelVAlign.title: Label V Align
labelVAlign.description: Vertical anchor point for the alignment of vLine label.

alpha.title: Alpha
alpha.description: This attribute determines the transparency of a data item. The range for this attribute is 0 to 100. 0 means complete transparency (the data item wont be shown on the graph) and 100 means opaque.

color.title: Color
color.description: If you want to define your own colors for the data items on chart, use this attribute to specify color for the data item.

dashed.title: Dashed
dashed.description: Whether the border of this data item should appear as dashed. This is particularly useful when you want to highlight a data (such as forecast or trend etc.).

anchorAlpha.title: Anchor Alpha
anchorAlpha.description: Lets you specify "set" specific alpha of the anchor.

anchorBgAlpha.title: Anchor Bg Alpha
anchorBgAlpha.description: Lets you specify "set" specific alpha of the anchor background.

anchorBgColor.title: Anchor Bg Color
anchorBgColor.description: Lets you specify "set" specific background color of the anchor.

anchorBorderColor.title: Anchor Border Color
anchorBorderColor.description: Lets you specify "set" specific border color of the anchor.

anchorBorderThickness.title: Anchor Border Thickness
anchorBorderThickness.description: Lets you specify "set" specific border thickness of the anchor.

anchorRadius.title: Anchor Radius
anchorRadius.description: Lets you specify "set" specific radius (in pixels) of the anchor.

anchorSides.title: Anchor Sides
anchorSides.description: Lets you specify "set" specific sides of the anchor.

anchorStartAngle.title: Anchor Start Angle
anchorStartAngle.description:
This attribute sets the starting angle for an anchor of a particular data.  

Default value: 90

displayValue.title: Display Value
displayValue.description: If instead of the numerical value of this data, you wish to display a custom string value, you can specify the same here. Examples are annotation for a data item etc.

link.title: Link
link.description: You can define links for individual data items. That enables the end user to click on data items (columns, lines, bars etc.) and drill down to other pages. To define the link for data items, use the link attribute. You can define links that open in same window, new window, pop-up window or frames. Please see "Drill-Down > Using JavaScript Functions as Links" for more information. Also, you'll need to Url Encode all the special characters (like ? and &) present in the link.

showValue.title: Show Value
showValue.description: You can individually opt to show/hide values of individual data items using this attribute. This value over-rides the dataset level value.

valueFontColor.title: Value Font Color
valueFontColor.description: Specifies the font color of data values for a particular dataset.

valueBgColor.title: Value Bg Color
valueBgColor.description: Sets the background color of value text for a particular dataset.

valueBorderColor.title: Value Border Color
valueBorderColor.description: Sets the border color around the value text for a particular dataset.

showLabel.title: Show Label
showLabel.description: You can individually opt to show/hide labels of individual data items using this attribute.

toolText.title: Tool Text
toolText.description: By default, FusionCharts XT shows the series name, category name, and value as tool tip text for that data item. But, if you want to display more information for the data item as tool tip, you can use this attribute to specify the same.

value.title: Value
value.description: Numerical value for the data item. This value will be plotted on the chart.

valuePosition.title: Value Position
valuePosition.description: If you've opted to show a particular data value on the chart, this attribute lets you adjust the vertical alignment of individual data values with respect to dataplots. By default, this attribute is set to AUTO mode in which the alignment of a data value is determined automatically based on the position of its plot point. In ABOVE mode, a data value is displayed above the plot point unless a plot point is too close to the upper edge of the canvas while in BELOW mode, a data value is displayed below the plot point unless a plot point is too close to the lower edge of the canvas.

anchorHoverColor.title: Anchor Hover Color
anchorHoverColor.description: This attribute can set the hover color for a particular anchor.

anchorHoverAlpha.title: Anchor Hover Alpha
anchorHoverAlpha.description: This attribute sets the transparency for an anchor when hovered.

anchorHoverSides.title: Anchor Hover Sides
anchorHoverSides.description: This attribute sets the number of sides for a particular anchor when hovered.

anchorBgHoverColor.title: Anchor Bg Hover Color
anchorBgHoverColor.description: This attribute sets the background color of a particular anchor when hovered.

anchorBgHoverAlpha.title: Anchor Bg Hover Alpha
anchorBgHoverAlpha.description: This attribute sets the transparency for a particular anchor’s background when hovered.

anchorBorderHoverColor.title: Anchor Border Hover Color
anchorBorderHoverColor.description: Sets the border color of an anchor when hovered.

anchorBorderHoverAlpha.title: Anchor Border Hover Alpha
anchorBorderHoverAlpha.description: Sets the border's transparency of an anchor when hovered.

anchorBorderHoverThickness.title: Anchor Border Hover Thickness
anchorBorderHoverThickness.description: This attribute sets the border thickness of an anchor when hovered.

anchorHoverStartAngle.title: Anchor Hover Start Angle
anchorHoverStartAngle.description: This attribute sets the starting angle of an anchor when hovered.

anchorHoverDip.title: Anchor Hover Dip
anchorHoverDip.description:
This attribute adds a dip effect (different shapes) to a particular anchor on hover. When hovered a star shaped anchor is created. Using `anchorSides` attribute, you can specify the no. of sides for anchors. 
`Note : If the anchors are of circular shape, this attribute won't be applied on it.`

startValue.title: Start Value
startValue.description: The starting value for the trendline. Say, if you want to plot a slanted trendline from value 102 to 109, the `startValue` will be 102.

endValue.title: End Value
endValue.description: The ending y-axis value for the trendline. Say, if you want to plot a slanted trendline from value 102 to 109, the `endValue` will be 109. If you do not specify a value for `endValue`, it will automatically assume the same value as `startValue`.

displayValue.title: Display Value
displayValue.description: If you want to display a string caption for the trend line by its side, you can use this attribute. Example: `displayValue='Last Month High'`. When you don't supply this attribute, it automatically takes the value of `startValue`.

color.title: Color
color.description: Color of the trend line and its associated text

isTrendZone.title: Is Trend Zone
isTrendZone.description: Whether the trend will be displayed as a line or a zone (fill-colored rectangle).

showOnTop.title: Show On Top
showOnTop.description: Whether the trend line/zone will be displayed over data plots or under them.

thickness.title: Thickness
thickness.description: If you've opted to show the trend as a line, this attribute lets you define the thickness of trend line.

dashed.title: Dashed
dashed.description:
Whether the trendline should be rendered as dashed lines. 

__Default value__: 0 (trendline rendered using straight lines)

dashLen.title: Dash Len
dashLen.description: Sets the width of each dash when trendline is rendered as dashed lines.

dashGap.title: Dash Gap
dashGap.description: Sets the gap between consecutive dashes when trendline is rendered as dashed lines.

valueOnRight.title: Value On Right
valueOnRight.description: Whether to show the trend line value on left side or right side of chart. This is particularly useful when the trend line display values on the chart are colliding with divisional lines values on the chart.

payload.description: The multi-series area chart is rendered with data values pointed as data points that are connected using line segments. The area between the line segments and the x-axis/edges of other charts is filled with color. This chart puts emphasis on the magnitude of change over time and effectively highlights the total value across a trend. For example, when visualizing sales data, this chart can be used to show total sales over time.

labelDisplay.title: Label Display
labelDisplay.description: Using this attribute, you can customize the alignment of data labels (x-axis labels). There are 5 options: AUTO, WRAP, STAGGER, ROTATE or NONE. By default, this attribute is set to AUTO mode which means that the alignment of the data labels is determined automatically depending on the size of the chart. WRAP wraps the label text if it is too long to fit in one line. ROTATE rotates the labels vertically. STAGGER divides the labels into multiple lines.

alternateVGridAlpha.title: Alternate V Grid Alpha
